Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Thai** | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago (West Loop) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu with dishes such as Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), and a variety of curries made with tofu or vegetables. |
| **Thai House** | 1401 N. Clark St., Chicago (Near North Side) | Provides a separate vegetarian menu featuring Pad See Ew, Green Curry, and a selection of fresh spring rolls. |
| **Baan Thai** | 2000 W. 19th St., Chicago (West Side) | Known for its “Vegetarian” section on the menu, including vegetarian Pad Krapow, Massaman curry with tofu, and a range of vegetable stir‑fries. |
| **The Thai Kitchen** | 400 N. Clark St., Chicago (Loop) | Offers vegetarian options such as Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Kha Gai (vegetarian version), and a vegetarian “Curry” platter. |
| **Siam Square** | 1200 W. 18th St., Chicago (West Loop) | Has a vegetarian menu featuring Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and a vegetarian green curry. |

If you’d like more details about any of these places—like hours, phone numbers, or specific vegetarian dishes—just let me know!
